plans.ligne: I'm literally an AI setter, and I'm begging you: do not fire your human setter.
plans.jeu: Walking selfie, frustrated and urgent, high energy: free hand pressed toward the lens pleading on 'begging you', shaking slightly, then a sharp index finger jab at the camera on 'do not fire', eyebrows high, jaw tense, intense eyes, constant micro-movements.

flow.note: 1er essai refusé par Flow (« prominent people », faux positif, remboursé) ; 2e essai sans le prénom dans le prompt : OK

plans.ligne_gardee: do not fire your human setter.

plans.ligne: Every ad says replace your setter with AI. Let the AI take the 11 p.m. "how much", your human takes the calls. That's exactly why we built ManySetter.
plans.jeu: Walking selfie, then he stops abruptly and brings the phone closer; rolls his eyes on 'every ad', counts on his fingers on '11 p.m.', firm hand chop on 'takes the calls', then a confident half smile. Talks fast, no pauses, casual and natural.
plans.prompt_veo: Vertical 9:16 handheld selfie video, front camera held at arm's length. The man from the start frame walks down a dim apartment hallway, background soft and barely readable. He suddenly stops, brings the phone closer to his face and talks straight into the lens, fed up and urgent, high energy. He rolls his eyes on "every ad", counts on his fingers on "11 p.m.", does a firm hand chop on "takes the calls", then gives a confident half smile. Constant small natural movements, slight handheld shake, real skin texture. He says, fast and without pausing between sentences: "Every ad says replace your setter with AI. Let the AI take the 11 p.m. 'how much', your human takes the calls. That's exactly why we built ManySetter." Voice: warm American male voice, mid-low pitch, projects his voice loud and punchy like a creator talking to his phone, quick confident delivery, slightly breathy from walking, one tiny natural stumble, General American accent. Audio: only his voice and quiet room tone, no music. No subtitles, no text on screen.
